summary: Iteration 8 retest of the iteration-7 follow-ups. Backend: 120/120 pytest pass, including the new tests/test_iter8_singleflight.py (18 tests). (1) Parking single-flight works: two concurrent POST /api/parking calls for a cold, random TEST_SF place returned identical bodies, the log has exactly one 'parking TEST_SF_89300a ->' line, and a third call came back from cache in under 3s. After a backend restart (cold cache), /api/agent 'I need fuel' and then an immediate /api/parking for the same place logged exactly ONE vision check for each of the 6 places (in iteration 7 the chosen place was checked twice). /api/parking reused the in-flight warm-up check (5.0s and 2.6s). (2) /api/speak single-flight works: two concurrent calls with the same text returned the same audio_url, the audio is fetchable, and a repeat call is cached (<2s). Empty text returns 422. (3) _tip filters the 'No suitable … visible', 'not visible', 'unclear', 'none', 'N/A', 'can't tell' and 'unable to' patterns and keeps real directions. The regex still misses some phrasings (see minor issues). (4) Main map at 375x667 with a fake mic: /api/parking is now called even when /api/voice already returned cached parking, so followParking runs for every stop. With /api/parking mocked (1s delay, likely verdict plus tips), the card updated 0.1s after the parking response (9.79s) while the reply was still playing. /api/speak for the tips was called only after the reply ended (14.94s), then the tips caption appeared. (5) Onboarding Type instead: the status box collapses (onboarding-heard is 0px tall) and the Height input moved up from y≈390 to y=337, with Weight at y=517 above the footer. The hazmat switch (y=603) and the error (y=653-685) are still under or below the sticky Next footer (y=595-651). (6) A silent mic shows only the caption 'Sorry, I didn't catch that. Try again.' with no toast. Regression: the main voice flow ('I need fuel') sets the route in about 5.8s, and the onboarding voice conversation goes from start to the map in 45.9s with the truck chip at 13'6" · 53' · 80k lb. No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView issues found.

minor.issue: The regex misses some negative phrasings. 'Not clear from image', 'Entrance unclear', 'Hard to tell', 'There is no visible entrance' and 'Nothing suitable' all pass through as tips. 'No. 3 driveway' is wrongly dropped because of ^no\b. Consider prompt-level guidance (return null when unsure) plus a broader regex, e.g. \b(unclear|not (clear|obvious|visible)|no visible|hard to tell|nothing suitable)\b.

ui_bugs.issue: The myTurn !== turn.current guard also gates the card update. If the driver taps the mic again (beginListening increments turn) before /api/parking returns, the parking result is thrown away even though the destination has not changed, and the card stays 'Truck parking unclear'. Gate only the speech on myTurn and the card update on place.id.

This is still not fixed from iteration 7. After typing the name and tapping Next, the truck step opens in voice mode (onboarding-type-button is visible and height inputs stay hidden for 5s), so the driver has to tap Type instead again.

issues: The spacing improved: Height moved from y≈390 to y=337. The hazmat switch (y=603, 40x20) is still covered by the sticky Next footer (595-651), and onboarding-truck-error (y=653-685) sits below the footer and partly off-screen, so the validation message cannot be seen without scrolling. Reduce the top block further (the agent bubble and thought dots take about 80px) or scroll the error into view when it appears.

The tips TTS (/api/speak) starts only after the reply finishes, which leaves a gap of about 1.8s (14.94s to 16.7s) before the tips are heard. Start api.speak(text) as soon as the parking result arrives, then await replyDone before playing.
On catch (network, 422 or 502), showToast(msg) and setCaption({reply: msg}) still show the same text twice. Only the silent-mic path was de-duplicated.

action_items: followParking: apply the card update whenever activeRef.current.place.id === place.id; use the myTurn check only for speaking.
Prefetch the tips TTS while the reply is playing (call api.speak before await replyDone).
Widen the NEGATIVE_TIP patterns and stop dropping 'No. N ...' directions.
Onboarding: keep Type instead mode across steps, and keep the truck error and hazmat row visible above the sticky footer at 375x667.
Remove the duplicate toast and caption in submitTurn's catch path.
critical_code_review_comments: check_parking and /api/speak single-flight use asyncio.shield plus a done_callback pop, which is correct. If a caller is cancelled, the shared task keeps running and other waiters are unaffected.
_check_parking re-checks _verdict_cache, which is harmless. Failures are cached through _fail_cache, so there are no retries storms.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (items 1,2,3,4,6 verified; item 5 partially improved, hazmat/error still hidden under the footer)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. Created in-memory parking cache entries for TEST_SF_* places and one TEST speak line.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same fake mic as iteration 7: add_init_script(path='/tmp/fakemic.js') and page.route('**/__fake/*') to serve /tmp/<name>.mp3. window.__next='q' gives a fuel query; 'silence' and 'gib' also exist. For onboarding use window.__seq=['onb_name','onb_truck','onb_prefs']. Restart the backend for a cold parking cache, then run tests/probe_iter8_warm_singleflight.py to count vision checks per place. To check card and speech timing, mock /api/parking with a delay and set parking=null in the /api/voice response.
